preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 10000, inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(N) <= 18 for N in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case N is a string of digits with length between 1 and 18, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case.
Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the rank.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= factorial(len(N)) for N, line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1:], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case N, the rank is a positive integer not exceeding the number of permutations of its digits (factorial of its length).

postconditions.expression: all(rank == sum(1 for perm in permutations(N) if perm < N) + 1 for N, rank in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1:], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The rank of N is the count of distinct permutations of its digits that are lexicographically smaller than N, plus one (1-based index).
